name: Kousoku Yakou Bus
source:
A depraved college student on summer vacation
touches little girls on the night bus back to his hometown.
What sort of naughtiness happens in the dark?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ127313.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个堕落的大学生在暑假期间，乘坐返回故乡的夜行巴士，对年幼女孩上下其手。
黑暗中究竟会发生怎样的淫乱之事？

（来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ127313.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]）
